SPXI-gnΩsis is a paid service that opens existing knowledge compositions against their sources and constructs sourced knowledge objects for entities and operators. It primarily functions by opening pinned Wikipedia revision sentences by sentence, ensuring each sentence is kept verbatim and read twice against the sources it cites, with every quotation located by code in the stored source.
